# Capoeira
Capoeira, the Syndicate's dance of war originating in Brazil, is a [textlink="martial art" link="MartialArts"] that disguises violence as beauty. Swift attacks link into flowing combos, each move faster and harder than the last one, fueled by relentless momentum.
## Special abilities
### Capoeira Stance
Through swift motion, Capoeira masters channel speed into energy. Every combo hits harder the faster you are moving when it lands, scaling all the way up to quadruple strength at a full sprint. Damage, knockdown duration and stamina damage all scale together.
Halt their flow, and their strength will vanish. Standing still strips the bonus entirely, and no combo except Kick Up can be performed while prone.
### Capoeira Momentum
Through the flowing, relentless motion of Capoeira, each successful combo restores the user's stamina. Every connected strike fuels their endurance, allowing them to fight longer, faster, and harder without pause.
The heavier the combo, the more it restores. This does not scale with speed.
### Capoeira Tempo
Hit or miss, it's just part of the dance! And the best part is about to start!
A missed bare-handed swing sharpens the next one, refunding most of its recovery and doubling its damage for a few seconds. Swinging a held weapon does nothing.
## Combo attacks
### Push Kick
Knocks down the opponent, makes them drop what they are holding, and hurls them away from you.
### Circle Kick
A swift kick to the chest that slows the opponent down significantly.
### Sweep Kick
Knocks down and deals stamina damage. Temporarily increases the user's attack speed. Cannot be performed if the user is moving too slow.
### Spin Kick
Deals a lot of damage, knocks the opponent down and breaks any grab on them. Also makes the user flip, and increases their attack speed. Only works on standing opponents. Cannot be performed if the user is moving too slow.
### Kick Up
Needs to be targeted at the user themselves. Can be performed while prone. Removes the knock down status effect and forces the user to stand up instantly, without waiting it out.
